newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Raffles sees Cambodian hotels opening on time.
newsitem.headline: Raffles sees Cambodian hotels opening on time.

text.p: Singapore's Raffles Holdings, a subsidiary of DBS Land, said on Monday it expected its two refurbished hotels in Cambodia to open close to schedule despite the violence which shook the country earlier this month.
It said in a statement the evacuation of expatriate staff had affected restoration, but local contractors had kept on working.
The Hotel Le Royal in Phnom Penh was now scheduled to open on September 22 instead of late August, the statement said.
The Grand Hotel d'Angkor remained on schedule for a mid-November opening, it said.
